result.instructions: Tools for CargoRomania, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my cargo postings have offers waiting, and what did each carrier offer?"; "Show my active transports with their km remaining and ETA."; "Publish a 18 t general cargo from Bucuresti to Milano for 14 November at 1850 EUR.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes CargoRomania data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cargoromania_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cargoromania_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cargoromania_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cargoromania_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_my_cargo
tools.title: List my cargo
tools.description: List the cargo postings of your company with their status (active, pending, expired, deleted or all). Returns only your company's cargo. Vendor: GET /cargo.

external_id.description: Your own ERP/TMS id that was sent as 'oid' when publishing.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_cargo
tools.title: Get a cargo posting
tools.description: Get one cargo posting by id: route, dates, weight, pallets, price, status and stops. Carriers can read an active cargo that they want to offer on. Vendor: GET /cargo/{id}.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_cargo_pricing
tools.title: Get AI price guidance for cargo
tools.description: Get the vendor's AI price guidance for one cargo: recommended price, market average, fuel, tolls, estimated carrier cost and margin. Vendor: GET /cargo/{id}/pricing.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

annotations.title: Get AI price guidance for cargo

tools.name: cargoromania_get_cargo_matches
tools.title: Get recommended carriers for cargo
tools.description: List the carriers the vendor recommends for one of your cargo postings, with a match score and the reasons. Vendor: GET /cargo/{id}/matches.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_cargo_offers
tools.title: List offers on my cargo
tools.description: List the offers that carriers sent on one of your cargo postings. Vendor: GET /cargo/{id}/offers.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_my_offers
tools.title: List my offers
tools.description: List the offers your company sent to cargo postings (carrier view). Vendor: GET /offers.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_offer_negotiation
tools.title: Get an offer negotiation
tools.description: Read the message and counter-offer thread of one offer. Vendor: GET /offers/{id}/negotiation.

offer_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_transports
tools.title: List transports
tools.description: List your transports (accepted jobs). With active=true, each one includes its current position, km remaining and ETA. Vendor: GET /transports.

active.description: true = include the live position, km remaining and ETA of each transport.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_transport
tools.title: Get a transport
tools.description: Get one transport: parties, route, status, tracking snapshot and documents. Vendor: GET /transports/{id}.

transport_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_transport_tracking
tools.title: Get transport tracking
tools.description: Get the live tracking of one transport: current position, route, km remaining, ETA and stops. Vendor: GET /transports/{id}/tracking.

transport_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_transport_documents
tools.title: List transport documents
tools.description: List the documents of one transport (CMR, proof of delivery, photos, invoices). Downloads are not exposed by this server. Vendor: GET /transports/{id}/documents.

transport_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the transport invoices your company issued and received, with totals and status. Vendor: GET /invoices.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice: lines, VAT, total and payment status. Vendor: GET /invoices/{id}.

invoice_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_trucks
tools.title: List my trucks
tools.description: List the trucks in your company fleet with capacity, current city and availability. Vendor: GET /trucks.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_empty_trucks
tools.title: List available trucks
tools.description: List trucks that announced free capacity (empty legs). Set mine=true for your own company only. Vendor: GET /empty-trucks.

tools.name: cargoromania_list_alerts
tools.title: List cargo alerts
tools.description: List your saved cargo alerts (route, country, truck type and weight filters). Vendor: GET /alerts.

tools.name: cargoromania_get_recommended_cargo
tools.title: Get recommended cargo
tools.description: List cargo postings the vendor recommends for your fleet, with a score and reasons. Vendor: GET /recommended.

tools.name: cargoromania_publish_cargo
tools.title: Publish a cargo posting
tools.description: Publish a new cargo posting that carriers can see and offer on. It is public on the exchange. Pass external_id (your ERP/TMS id) so a repeated call returns a duplicate error instead of a second posting. Vendor: POST /cargo.

truck_type.description: Vehicle type code from the vendor's list, e.g. 'prelata' (curtainsider).

price.description: Price in the given currency, excluding VAT.

currency.description: Money currency (default EUR on the vendor side).

external_id.description: Your own id, sent as 'oid' to prevent duplicates.

tools.name: cargoromania_update_cargo
tools.title: Update a cargo posting
tools.description: Change fields of one of your cargo postings. Only the fields you pass are changed. Repeating the same call gives the same result. Vendor: POST /cargo/{id}.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

currency.description: Money currency (default EUR on the vendor side).

tools.name: cargoromania_cancel_cargo
tools.title: Cancel a cargo posting
tools.description: Cancel one of your cargo postings. Carriers then can no longer offer on it. Vendor: POST /cargo/{id}/cancel.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

tools.name: cargoromania_submit_offer
tools.title: Send an offer on cargo
tools.description: Send a price offer on an active cargo posting, as a carrier. To withdraw it later, use cargoromania_reject_offer. Accepting an offer is not offered by this server. Vendor: POST /cargo/{id}/offers.

cargo_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.

available_from.description: Date the truck is available, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: cargoromania_reject_offer
tools.title: Reject or withdraw an offer
tools.description: Reject an offer you received (as a shipper) or withdraw your own offer (as a carrier). Vendor: POST /offers/{id}/reject.

offer_id.description: The id from a previous tool result.
